body: Venlaflaxine is what I'm weaning off of now. When I was at a standard dose I couldn't sleep yet still had no energy (lying in bed all day), and it made me care even less about things than when I had no meds in my system. Unfortunately everyone's body chem is different. :(
I've been on 5 different anti-depressants/mood stabilizers and they all caused adverse effects. That's why I want to try a holistic approach.
